verdict.rationale: Ardent documents isolated, instant Postgres branches with 'Unlimited branches per database', scale-to-zero compute, no storage duplication and idle-free pricing. Branches can be created per agent or per PR and are scriptable through a CLI with JSON output, token auth and idempotent re-runs, plus an API aimed at agent workflows. However, these are branches cloned from a production source rather than fresh per-tenant databases, and nothing shows operation at thousands-scale or bulk fleet operations, so the story is only partly covered. missing for 10: evidence of creating/operating thousands of databases cheaply at scale, documented one-database-per-tenant (non-clone) provisioning, fleet-level list/bulk lifecycle management APIs (no OpenAPI spec found), independent cost/scale corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can cheaply create thousands of isolated databases — one per agent, tenant, or preview — and manage the fleet programmatically

citations.quote: Clones load in 6s, scale to 0, autoscale compute and do not duplicate storage.
Every PR runs against its own fresh database branch cloned from your connected source
The agent runs the Ardent CLI itself — creating, using, and deleting its own branches
Use the API when you are building CI systems, internal developer platforms, custom dashboards, or agent workflows.
ardent branch info my-feature --format json # prints a stable JSON object
